items.difficulty_reason: Full construction theorem (statement 3174-3186, proof 3187-3337): the proof builds the complex explicitly, runs the Postnikov machine twice (system extension and map extension) on vanishing groups derived from the two assumptions, identifies the comparison complexes with the derived category's key Postnikov example, and finishes with an explicit three-row compatibility chase; the only two 'we omit the computation' spots are auxiliary verifications away from the main conclusion, recorded in the notes. H3: 151-line derived-categorical construction.
